provider: NASA JPL / CNES SWOT mission; distributed by NASA PO.DAAC
product: SWOT Level 2 Water Mask Raster Image 100m Data Product
version: D (CRID in each granule name, e.g. PID0)
attribution: SWOT (2025). SWOT Level 2 Water Mask Raster Image 100m Data Product, Version D. Ver. D. PO.DAAC, CA, USA. https://doi.org/10.5067/SWOT-RASTER-D. SWOT is a joint NASA/CNES mission with contributions from CSA and UKSA.
method: Mean of valid pixels whose centres fall in each res-6 cell inside the region box. SWOT L2 HR Raster 100 m: water_frac is the mean water fraction of observed pixels with water_area_qual ≤ 1 (suspect or better) over all passes; wse is the mean water-surface elevation of pixels with wse_qual ≤ 1 and water_frac > 0.5. Single-pass snapshots.
sampling: mean of pixel centres in cell
